title: Activated fibroblasts modify keratinocyte stem niche through TET1 and IL-6 to promote their rapid transformation in a mouse model of prenatal arsenic exposure.
ehr_evidence: The study used a BALB/c mouse model of prenatal arsenic exposure with primary dermal fibroblast and keratinocyte stem cell cultures; no electronic or computerised individual-level health records were used.
summary: In a BALB/c mouse model of prenatal arsenic exposure, activated dermal fibroblasts secrete IL-6 via TET1-mediated 5-hmC accumulation at the IL-6 promoter, driving JAK2/STAT3 signaling and EMT in unexposed keratinocyte stem cells to promote skin tumorigenesis.
key_findings: Prenatal arsenic exposure reduced E-cadherin (MFI 4.1 ± 0.6) and increased N-cadherin (MFI 8.5 ± 1.2), Vimentin (MFI 4.4 ± 0.2) and Fibronectin (MFI 8.6 ± 1.2) in offspring skin at 18 weeks versus controls.
α-SMA positive dermal fibroblast counts were higher in prenatally exposed offspring (26.2 ± 2.6) versus control (6.2 ± 1.0) at 18 weeks and (37 ± 2.7) versus (9.6 ± 1.2) at PND 2.
IL-6 levels in prenatally exposed dermal fibroblast lysates were higher (MFI 342.2 ± 31.6) than control (MFI 91 ± 14.4), and in supernatant (MFI 7919 ± 350.4) versus control (MFI 4086 ± 50.4).
TUNEL-positive apoptotic KSCs were reduced in IL-6-rich conditioned media (2 ± 0.3%) versus unexposed cells (10.4 ± 0.5%), indicating increased survival.
BrdU-positive proliferating KSCs increased to 11.2 ± 0.7% in IL-6-rich media versus 3 ± 0.8% in control, and declined to 3.4 ± 0.5% after pSTAT3 inhibition with SC144.

TET1 protein was upregulated 1.8 ± 0.06 fold and IL-6 mRNA 8.1 ± 1.4 fold in prenatally exposed fibroblasts, with an 8.4 ± 1.5% increase in 5-hmC/5-mC ratio at the IL-6 promoter versus 0.5 ± 0.1% in controls.
pSTAT3 inhibition with SC144 reduced N-cadherin from 1.8 ± 0.1 to 1.2 ± 0.14 fold, Vimentin from 1.7 ± 0.14 to 0.8 ± 0.09 fold, and Fibronectin from 1.8 ± 0.08 to 1.1 ± 0.07 fold.
captured_features: E-cadherin, N-cadherin, Vimentin, Fibronectin, α-SMA protein expression (MFI and positive cell counts per field)
IL-6 cytokine levels in cell lysate and supernatant (ELISA/MFI)
GP130, JAK2, STAT3, pSTAT3, pJAK2 protein levels
TET1 protein and IL-6 mRNA expression (fold change)
study_design: Experimental animal (mouse) model with in vitro primary cell culture and mechanistic intervention
population: BALB/c mice, prenatal (transplacental) arsenic exposure, offspring assessed at PND 2 and 18 weeks
limitations: Findings are derived from a mouse model and in vitro cell culture, limiting direct extrapolation to humans.
Mechanistic in vitro conditioned-media experiments do not fully recapitulate the in vivo tumor microenvironment.
data_availability_statement: The datasets generated and analyzed during the current study are submitted to CSIR-IITR repository and will be made available by corresponding author on request.
